## Notes

Paradox Development Studio, Paradox Interactive. PC 2020-09-01; PS5 and Xbox Series 2022-03-29. Start dates 867, 1066, 1178; ends 1453. Play continues with the heir on death; game ends without a viable heir; dynasty Renown. Six skills; personality, education, and genetic traits; stress from acting against traits can be lethal; six lifestyles with three skill trees each; prestige, gold, piety; levies, men-at-arms, knights.
